preconditions.description: The input integer n is between 4 and 1000 inclusive.
The input integer n is a multiple of 4.

postconditions.expression: len(rows) == n and all(len(row) == n for row in rows)
postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly n lines, each containing exactly n integers.
The grid contains every integer from 0 to n^2 - 1 exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(row_xor == target_xor for row_xor in row_xors)
postconditions.description: The bitwise XOR sum of every row is equal to a common value.

postconditions.expression: all(col_xor == target_xor for col_xor in col_xors)
postconditions.description: The bitwise XOR sum of every column is equal to the same common value as the rows.
